responsibility: This header declares the gm2 exception-construction interface used by frontend lowering code. It provides prototypes for initializing exception support and for building throw, try, and catch trees over GCC’s EH representation, acting as the C declaration layer for the runtime-binding and tree-building logic in m2except.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2except group: it supplies extern declarations for the exception-building functions to native frontend code, while m2except.def is the Modula-2 foreign-definition view and m2except.cc contains the executable GCC EH construction logic.
